name: Moving Parts
thesis: Raygen’s world unfolds as a set of connected architectural panels, each carrying a different part of a life spent making things.
interaction: Open the warm chapter spines or use the arrow controls to shift the entire composition; oversized type and real project artwork travel with their panel, while mobile becomes an uninterrupted vertical read.
why: The website behaves like a physical mechanism: precise connected movement, exposed printer assemblies, and a warm, emphatic personality rooted in Raygen’s love of building.
